description: ID3v2.4 extended header with restrictions $3E: ISO-8859-1 or UTF-8 only, strings of at most 30 characters, PNG or JPEG images of at most 64x64 pixels (section 3.2). The tag breaks each: a UTF-16 title of 40 characters, a GIF picture and a 100x80 PNG.

findings.contains: text to ISO-8859-1 and UTF-8, but frame TIT2 at 0x12 uses UTF-16
strings to 30 characters, but frame TIT2 at 0x12 holds one of 40
images to PNG and JPEG, but frame APIC at 0x6F holds image/gif
images to 64x64 pixels or less, but frame APIC at 0x99 holds one of 100x80
